summary: Two Georgia lookout lists place a Habersham County tower at an elevation of 1,474 (feet, if so 449 m); no build, staffing or fate found.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms list entry: Clarkesville Lookout Tower in Habersham County, elevation 1474 with no unit
Forest Lookouts Georgia list names Clarkesville in Habersham County with no other detail
tnlandforms page is a bare Georgia lookout list with no site description

notes_for_editor: Only two lists found: tnlandforms GA066 (elevation, county) and the Forest Lookouts Georgia page (name and county, no status). The list prints no unit for elevation; feet is assumed (1,474 ft equals the brief's 449.3 m). Two web searches for a build date, builder or fire history found only the Chenocetah Mountain tower near Cornelia, a different structure, so it is not used. Status, access and staffing are unknown. The story is short because the evidence is thin. Confidence low.
